SIGNALS.name: NZ
SIGNALS.summary: A post says the name Helium has appeared in Gemini's model dropdown beside Argon, Carbon, Hydrogen and Neon, and guesses it may be a cheaper, faster Gemini 4 tier.

SIGNALS.name: Ansh Mehra
SIGNALS.summary: Post reports MeitY Secretary S. Krishnan defended Sarvam AI after criticism that it offers Chinese models on its Token Factory while being a government-selected indigenous model builder.

SIGNALS.name: Chinmay A. Singh
SIGNALS.summary: Commentary on the Sarvam debate: India needs sovereign AI and also needs data kept locally when non-sovereign AI is used, and one company is unlikely to deliver both.

SIGNALS.name: Andrew Curran
SIGNALS.summary: Relays a rumor, also mentioned on Scott Aaronson's blog, that Anthropic and OpenAI may have math results that could crack RSA. Unconfirmed.

SIGNALS.name: AGTP
SIGNALS.summary: Reports that Cognition released SWE-2.1, its new coding model, free for two weeks. It succeeds SWE-2 and is trained with reinforcement learning on Kimi K3.

SIGNALS.name: Polymarket
SIGNALS.summary: Polymarket reports South Africa is proposing a $5.7 million fund to support domestic AI startups, framed as a push to compete with the United States.

SIGNALS.name: OpenAI
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI shares a preprint with lab validation of protein design by its GPT-6 family. Of 322 proteins tested with a partner, 35 showed binding evidence, with binders for all five targets.
